items.hed: Texans routed the Chargers 44-22 at SoFi Stadium Sunday to improve to 3-5
items.insight: Houston's offense broke open a tight game at SoFi Stadium, beating the previously winless Chargers 44-22 Sunday to move to 3-5 on the season. Los Angeles fell to 0-8, ending a 37-drive touchdown drought — the second-longest in NFL history — on a fourth-quarter 58-yard Justin Herbert-to-Quentin Johnston score that only trimmed the margin. The win was Houston's clearest performance of the season heading into next week.

items.hed: The Rockets host the Denver Nuggets tonight at Toyota Center looking to bounce back from Saturday's loss at Phoenix
items.insight: Houston's official schedule has tipoff tonight, Monday, Nov. 9, at 7:30 p.m. Central at Toyota Center against Denver. The Rockets enter at 7-3 after Devin Booker's late scoring run lifted the Suns to a 102-99 win Saturday night, snapping Houston's five-game winning streak. A home win tonight would put the Rockets back on track early in the season.

items.hed: New GM Randy Flores says hiring a manager is his first priority as the Astros move toward this week's GM meetings
items.insight: A Houston Chronicle report carried by Yahoo Sports says Flores, hired about a month before a possible Dec. 1 labor lockout, has already interviewed a handful of candidates to replace Joe Espada and is taking over the search himself. Beat reporting this week described the Astros wanting to 'move fast' and owner Jim Crane wanting a 'big splash' hire; as of this morning no manager had been named.
